{{Top|leg}}
'''Lithium''' was an element used in a scam against the planet of [[Pesmenben IV]]. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] sprinkled lithium carbonate on its surface to fool the Governor to lease it to him.
